assets.label: Burning
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original painted UI effect asset for Breachline, a high-fantasy card game. The board is a linen war map over an oak camp table, viewed vertically from above. The attached linen image is REFERENCE ONLY for the material and palette the effect will be composited onto. DO NOT reproduce any cloth, wood, tacks, map, paper or solid background from that reference. Paint ONLY the requested effect on genuine transparent alpha. Traditional oil/acrylic painted realism: visible but quiet measured brushwork, believable materials, precise selectively resolved detail, never uniform noise. Not a photo, CGI, vector graphic or particle effect. Even upper-left lighting, exact top-down orthographic view, no perspective or cast shadow, no broad glow haze; software adds glow and motion later. No text, letters, numbers, runes, sigils, logos, watermarks, signatures, labels, diagrams or other UI. Semi-transparent delicate effect edges rather than a solid-color matte.
Canvas 1536 x 1024 landscape, 3:2. A single tile overlay arranged as a rectangular perimeter matching this canvas aspect ratio, not a circle or square in the middle. Effect band follows ALL FOUR outer edges, about 100 pixels deep, strongest at the four corners, thinning toward a nearly empty central region. Keep complete perimeter within frame with only a tiny transparent margin. Central 60% of the image area stays almost entirely clear transparent alpha, for unit art. Sides remain even with no single bulky motif in the middle of an edge; four corners have similar weight but natural differences. No artificial enclosing box outline except the material lines explicitly requested. No scene or character.
Burning ground. The rectangle's edges are singed: a band of brown-black char, as if the map had been scorched from beneath, with thin cracks of glowing orange ember running through it and a few low tongues of flame curling up at the corners. A few flecks of grey ash and one or two tiny embers drift toward the middle. Hot orange and deep red against black char. No smoke clouds and no bright white.
